intro: Amos was a shepherd and a fig farmer, called to warn the wealthy northern kingdom of Israel.
Chapters one and two judge the nations, then turn on Israel itself. Chapters three to six condemn worship without justice.
Chapters seven to nine are five visions, ending with a promise of restoration.
Amos spoke about seven hundred and sixty years before Christ.
Listen for his famous cry: let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.
